claim_boundary.allowed: turns three failed isolated-latch candidate runs into a smaller debug sequence with measurable stop gates
claim_boundary.not_allowed: does not prove a new circuit, SAR bit cycling, noise, offset statistics, extracted layout, DRC/LVS, or accepted post-layout converter evidence

debug_ladder.name: preamp_alone_dc_and_transient
debug_ladder.pass_gate: both signs produce measurable settled output before latch clock time
debug_ladder.question: can the preamp or buffer stage settle from the target-edge input without any regenerative latch attached?
debug_ladder.stop_if_fails: fix bias, load, common-mode, or initial condition before reconnecting the latch

must_measure: minimum input needed for full output
debug_ladder.name: latch_alone_from_measured_preamp_voltages
debug_ladder.pass_gate: both signs resolve with the polarity contract and full output swing
debug_ladder.question: can the latch resolve when driven by ideal voltage sources equal to the preamp-alone outputs?
debug_ladder.stop_if_fails: resize latch or change latch common-mode before adding sampled-node coupling

debug_ladder.name: clock_timing_ladder
debug_ladder.pass_gate: same topology measures under at least three clock spacings without timeout
debug_ladder.question: which copy, preamp, and latch clock order avoids timeout and stale initial conditions?
debug_ladder.stop_if_fails: separate clock phases further or add explicit precharge/reset nodes

debug_ladder.name: coupled_kickback_rejoin
debug_ladder.pass_gate: kickback <= 2.197265625e-04 V hard line, preferably <= 1.098632813e-04 V
debug_ladder.question: after the pieces work alone, does the coupled circuit keep sampled-node kickback below the line?
debug_ladder.stop_if_fails: return to isolation mechanism; do not proceed to SAR

debug_ladder.name: sar_threshold_wrong_code_proxy
debug_ladder.pass_gate: both signs stay correct under the same budget used by placement and converter acceptance
debug_ladder.question: does the measured decision stay correct at the SAR threshold after offset, noise, and kickback budgets are applied?
debug_ladder.stop_if_fails: keep digital fallback; do not create accepted post-layout converter evidence

failure_pattern: combined isolated-latch topologies are timing out before useful kickback or resolution measurements

failures.failure_reading: combined buffer plus latch fixture did not produce measured signal cases
failures.name: source_follower_input_buffer

failures.name: sampled_internal_decision_capacitor

failures.failure_reading: preamp plus delayed latch did not produce measured target-edge cases
failures.name: two_phase_preamp_then_latch
